claimBoundary: REALITY-0 compares the SCOPE-0 target envelope with repository/runtime-observable AS-IS. Fit is not deployment assurance; unverified and external evidence remain unresolved inputs for DECIDE-0, E3 or E4.

assessments.asIs: Compliance-lead and auditor professional lenses plus three runtime roles exist; buyer fit and representative operator validation are not repository facts.
assessments.decisionInput: Preserve current role/persona model; require E3-HUMAN operator/task validation before broad operator-fit claims.

assessments.asIs: Product journeys preserve original basis, human checkpoints, cross-process routing, evidence and verified closure while AI stays assistive.
assessments.decisionInput: No structural rewrite indicated by this dimension.

assessments.asIs: Exactly seven peer business procedures are canonical; EP-01 is cross-cutting and procedure disablement preserves history while blocking new work.
assessments.decisionInput: Preserve seven peer procedures and cross-cutting EP-01.

assessments.asIs: Loopback single-node is the default; optional multi-tenant and trusted-header network mode exist with server-side boundaries, while public bind, HA and production identity are not repository-proven.
assessments.decisionInput: Keep single-node primary; networked deployment remains conditional on E4 identity/scanner controls.

assessments.asIs: Serialized writes, abuse budgets, bounded pagination and historic stress mechanisms exist, but 50 users/tenant, 10 simultaneous sessions, 5 tenants/node and 10k active records/tenant are not end-to-end capacity benchmarks.
assessments.decisionInput: C3-CAPACITY-CONTRACT must establish measured budgets before any scale claim; no datastore rewrite is justified yet.

assessments.asIs: Canonical browser rails exercise Chromium-oriented desktop journeys and 390px responsive/a11y behavior; cross-engine and representative assistive-technology usability are outside repository proof.
assessments.decisionInput: Retain bounded client target; E3-HUMAN remains required for assistive-technology and task effectiveness.

assessments.asIs: The launcher, schema migration refusal, compatibility-aware rollback via pre-migration recovery point and recovery CLI are present, but delivery provenance/signing remains C2.
assessments.decisionInput: Preserve recovery-based rollback semantics; close C2 before claiming governed delivery provenance.

assessments.asIs: SQLite and tenant directories are customer-local by default; AI egress and attachment scanner boundaries are explicit, while universal regulated suitability is not claimed.
assessments.decisionInput: Preserve local-first residency; treat AI/scanner/key custody as boundary-changing deployment controls.

assessments.asIs: Encrypted, integrity-checked recovery points are implemented, but HA, off-host durability and approved RTO/RPO remain explicitly unproven and capacity is unverified.
assessments.decisionInput: Do not introduce HA by assumption; E4 defines recovery objectives and C3 defines capacity.

assessments.asIs: Manual/source-pack/external-reference intake, trusted upstream identity, optional AI and same-as-read exports preserve external master authority without mandatory bidirectional sync.
assessments.decisionInput: No integration platform or marketplace is justified by current target.

assessments.asIs: Admin/user/auditor are canonical; auditor mutation is denied by permission shape, tenant membership is server-side, and AI cannot acquire decision authority.
assessments.decisionInput: Preserve three-role core; organization-specific SoD remains configuration/deployment policy rather than universal workflow.

assessments.asIs: Repository gates can measure E2 structure and behavior, but representative task time, completion, comprehension, pleasantness and AT outcomes require E3-HUMAN evidence.
assessments.decisionInput: Do not synthesize market-fit/compliance/maturity scores from CI; define human baselines externally.

assessments.asIs: AS-IS is Node/vanilla/Store/SQLite with one composition root; no observed hard contradiction requires PostgreSQL, generic BPM, second store or global UI resolver.
assessments.decisionInput: Preserve current architecture by default; any structural change needs explicit DECIDE-0 evidence/rationale.

decisionHandoff.policy: REALITY-0 may classify fit, bounded fit, partial fit, unverified envelope, external dependency or contradiction; it may not itself authorize structural implementation. DECIDE-0 owns the decision.
